styles.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #1a1a1a !important; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00c9ff 0%, #92fe9d 50%, #00d2ff 100%) !important; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.innerContainer: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 0%, rgba(224, 255, 240, 0.9) 100%); border-radius: 24px; padding: 36px; margin: 28px 0; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
styles.innerContainer::before: content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; left: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, rgba(0, 201, 255, 0.1), transparent); animation: shimmer 3s infinite;
styles.h1: font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a1a; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #00c9ff; padding-bottom: 10px; margin: 32px 0 16px;
styles.h2: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #92fe9d, #26c6da); padding: 4px 10px; margin: 28px 0 14px;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; border-left: 4px solid #26c6da; padding-left: 12px; margin: 24px 0 12px;
styles.strong: font-weight: 700; color: #26c6da; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;
styles.a: color: #26c6da !important; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #26c6da; font-weight: 600;
styles.ul: margin: 16px 0; padding-left: 24px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); border-radius: 8px; padding: 15px;
styles.ol: margin: 16px 0; padding-left: 24px; counter-reset: item; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); border-radius: 8px; padding: 15px;
styles.li: margin: 10px 0; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #1a1a1a !important; position: relative; padding-left: 25px;
styles.blockquote: margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); border-left: 5px solid #26c6da; color: #1a1a1a !important; font-style: italic; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
styles.code: font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: #26c6da; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
styles.pre: margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00c9ff22, #92fe9d22); border-radius: 12px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6 !important; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
styles.hr: margin: 32px 0; border: none; height: 4px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #00c9ff, #00c9ff 10px, #92fe9d 10px, #92fe9d 20px); border-radius: 2px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; max-height: 600px !important; height: auto; display: block; margin: 20px auto; border-radius: 12px; border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
styles.table: width: 100%; margin: 20px 0; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
styles.th: background: linear-gradient(45deg, #00c9ff, #92fe9d); color: #1a1a1a !important; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;
